<section id="help" class="alt">
 <div class="wrap split">
  <div class="rv rv-l">
   <span class="eyebrow">Get involved</span>
   <h2 class="t">Volunteer or fundraise for us</h2>
   <p class="lead">Individual fundraising offers a fantastic opportunity to support a local charity. Can you use your creativity & talents to help fundraise for Community Wishes?</p>
   <div class="vol"><div class="bgc"></div><div><h3 style="font-size:1.4rem;margin-bottom:6px">Become a volunteer</h3><p>Contact Gez Varney at <a href="mailto:gez.communitywishes@gmail.com">gez.communitywishes@gmail.com</a> or call <a href="tel:07805575955">07805 575955</a>. This is one of the most rewarding jobs with the charity, as our volunteers can testify.</p></div></div>
  </div>
  <ul class="ideas rv rv-r">
   <li><span class="k">1</span><span><b>A Sponsored Challenge</b>Could you take on a marathon or tackle the Three Peaks?</span></li>
   <li><span class="k">2</span><span><b>A Sponsored Activity</b>Set a target number of steps or cover a certain distance by running, walking, cycling or swimming.</span></li>
   <li><span class="k">3</span><span><b>Creative Sale</b>Whether it's baking cakes, making samosas, crafting, or growing plants, use your talents to sell for donations.</span></li>
   <li><span class="k">4</span><span><b>Plan an Event</b>Host a curry evening, run a raffle, or set up a dress-down day at work.</span></li>
  </ul>
 </div>
</section>

<section id="donate">
 <div class="wrap">
  <div class="donate rv rv-s">
   <div class="bgc" data-par="0.1" aria-hidden="true"></div>
   <span class="eyebrow" style="color:var(--gold2)">Make a wish come true</span>
   <h2>Your gift makes <em>a difference</em></h2>
   <p>We rely on community support & generosity. Every donation helps us grant wishes to people facing financial hardship, illness or disability across Leicester.</p>
   <div class="amts" aria-label="Choose an amount"><a class="donate-link" href="#">£10</a><a class="donate-link" href="#">£25</a><a class="donate-link" href="#">£50</a><a class="donate-link" href="#">£100</a><a class="donate-link" href="#">Other</a></div>
   <a class="btn btn-w donate-link" href="#">Donate securely →</a>
   <div class="pay" aria-label="Payment methods">
    <a class="donate-link" href="#" aria-label="Donate by card">💳 Card</a>
    <a class="donate-link" href="#" aria-label="Donate with Visa" style="color:#1a1f71;font-style:italic;font-weight:900;letter-spacing:.04em">VISA</a>
    <a class="donate-link" href="#" aria-label="Donate with Mastercard"><svg width="30" height="18" viewBox="0 0 30 18" aria-hidden="true"><circle cx="10" cy="9" r="9" fill="#eb001b"/><circle cx="20" cy="9" r="9" fill="#f79e1b" fill-opacity=".9"/></svg>Mastercard</a>
    <a class="donate-link" href="#" aria-label="Donate with Apple Pay"> Pay</a>
    <a class="donate-link" href="#" aria-label="Donate with Google Pay"><span style="color:#4285f4">G</span> Pay</a>
   </div>
   <p class="secure">🔒 Payments processed securely by our payment provider · Registered charity 1196244</p>
  </div>
 </div>
</section>

<div class="lb" id="lb" role="dialog" aria-modal="true" aria-label="Photo viewer"><button class="x" aria-label="Close">✕</button><button class="pv" aria-label="Previous photo">‹</button><img alt=""><button class="nx" aria-label="Next photo">›</button><p class="cap"></p></div>
<script>
/* ===== DONATION_URL: replace with your real donation page (Stripe Payment Link, JustGiving, PayPal…) ===== */
const DONATION_URL = "https://donate.stripe.com/REPLACE_WITH_YOUR_LINK";
document.querySelectorAll('.donate-link').forEach(a=>{a.href=DONATION_URL;a.target="_blank";a.rel="noopener"});
const RM=matchMedia('(prefers-reduced-motion: reduce)').matches;
document.getElementById('yr').textContent=new Date().getFullYear();
// nav
const hdr=document.getElementById('hdr'),b=document.querySelector('.burger'),m=document.getElementById('menu');
const setMenu=o=>{m.classList.toggle('open',o);b.setAttribute('aria-expanded',o);b.setAttribute('aria-label',o?'Close menu':'Open menu')};
b.onclick=()=>setMenu(!m.classList.contains('open'));
m.querySelectorAll('a').forEach(a=>a.addEventListener('click',()=>setMenu(false)));
// reveal
const io=new IntersectionObserver(e=>e.forEach(x=>{if(x.isIntersecting){x.target.classList.add('in');io.unobserve(x.target)}}),{threshold:.12,rootMargin:'0px 0px -40px'});
document.querySelectorAll('.rv').forEach(el=>io.observe(el));
// parallax + header
const par=[...document.querySelectorAll('[data-par]')];
function onScroll(){hdr.classList.toggle('s',scrollY>40);if(RM)return;const vh=innerHeight;
 par.forEach(el=>{const r=el.parentElement.getBoundingClientRect();if(r.bottom<0||r.top>vh)return;const c=(r.top+r.height/2-vh/2);el.style.transform=`translate3d(0,${-c*el.dataset.par}px,0)`})}
addEventListener('scroll',()=>requestAnimationFrame(onScroll),{passive:true});onScroll();
// star particles
if(!RM){const cv=document.getElementById('stars'),cx=cv.getContext('2d');let W,H,P=[];
 function rs(){W=cv.width=cv.offsetWidth*devicePixelRatio;H=cv.height=cv.offsetHeight*devicePixelRatio;P=Array.from({length:Math.min(110,W/14|0)},()=>({x:Math.random()*W,y:Math.random()*H,r:(Math.random()*1.8+.4)*devicePixelRatio,v:(Math.random()*.25+.05)*devicePixelRatio,t:Math.random()*6.28,s:Math.random()*.03+.01,g:Math.random()<.25}))}
 rs();addEventListener('resize',rs);
 (function f(){cx.clearRect(0,0,W,H);for(const p of P){p.y-=p.v;p.t+=p.s;if(p.y<-10){p.y=H+10;p.x=Math.random()*W}
  const a=.35+.65*Math.abs(Math.sin(p.t));cx.globalAlpha=a;cx.fillStyle=p.g?'#ffd97a':'#fff';cx.beginPath();cx.arc(p.x,p.y,p.r,0,6.28);cx.fill();
  if(p.r>1.6*devicePixelRatio&&a>.85){cx.globalAlpha=a*.6;cx.fillRect(p.x-p.r*4,p.y-.5,p.r*8,1);cx.fillRect(p.x-.5,p.y-p.r*4,1,p.r*8)}}
  requestAnimationFrame(f)})()}
// gallery
const gal=document.getElementById('gal'),items=[...gal.querySelectorAll('.g')],moreBtn=document.getElementById('moreBtn');
const LIMIT=24;let cat='all',clip=true;
function apply(){let n=0;items.forEach(g=>{const ok=cat==='all'||g.dataset.cat===cat;g.classList.toggle('hide',!ok);g.classList.remove('extra');if(ok){n++;if(n>LIMIT)g.classList.add('extra')}});
 gal.classList.toggle('clip',clip);moreBtn.parentElement.style.display=(n>LIMIT&&clip)?'':'none';moreBtn.textContent=`Show all ${n} photos`}
document.querySelectorAll('.filters button').forEach(btn=>btn.onclick=()=>{document.querySelectorAll('.filters button').forEach(x=>x.setAttribute('aria-selected',x===btn));cat=btn.dataset.f;clip=true;apply()});
moreBtn.onclick=()=>{clip=false;apply()};apply();
// lightbox
const lb=document.getElementById('lb'),li=lb.querySelector('img'),cap=lb.querySelector('.cap');let cur=0,vis=[],last;
function show(i){cur=(i+vis.length)%vis.length;const im=vis[cur].querySelector('img');li.src=im.src;li.alt=im.alt;cap.textContent=`${im.alt.replace(/^.*– /,'')} · ${cur+1} / ${vis.length}`}
items.forEach(g=>g.onclick=()=>{vis=items.filter(x=>!x.classList.contains('hide'));last=g;show(vis.indexOf(g));lb.classList.add('open');document.body.style.overflow='hidden';lb.querySelector('.x').focus()});
function close(){lb.classList.remove('open');document.body.style.overflow='';last&&last.focus()}
lb.querySelector('.x').onclick=close;lb.querySelector('.pv').onclick=()=>show(cur-1);lb.querySelector('.nx').onclick=()=>show(cur+1);
lb.onclick=e=>{if(e.target===lb)close()};
addEventListener('keydown',e=>{if(!lb.classList.contains('open'))return;if(e.key==='Escape')close();if(e.key==='ArrowLeft')show(cur-1);if(e.key==='ArrowRight')show(cur+1)});
let tx=0;lb.addEventListener('touchstart',e=>tx=e.touches[0].clientX,{passive:true});lb.addEventListener('touchend',e=>{const d=e.changedTouches[0].clientX-tx;if(Math.abs(d)>50)show(cur+(d<0?1:-1))});
</script>
</body>
</html>
